questions.stem: Which statement best defines Colour grading?

It is the intensity or purity of a colour as it appears in the image.

Option D ("use of hue to suggest abstract ideas or emotional states") is wrong: Confuses Colour grading with Colour symbolism.
questions.hint: Recall the specific meaning of Colour grading.
